description: Up to 20 read ops (balance, token, code, nonce, tx, block, gas, network) in ONE call, passed as a JSON array in the ops query param. Each op is isolated: a bad op returns an error object, never fails the batch. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: GET https://api.firstmention.uk/s/chainread/multiread

ops.description: JSON array of up to 20 op objects. Example: [{"op":"balance","address":"0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006"},{"op":"gas"}]

name: chainread__multiread
